description: Check whether a domain can be registered and get an INDICATIVE retail price. IMPORTANT: this is a read-only lookup — it does NOT buy, register, reserve, or pay for any domain, and it changes nothing. The returned price is GROSS (includes 21% VAT) and indicative only. Set alternatives:true to also check the same name across other common TLDs (be, com, net, eu, nl, io, dev, app). Requires a valid team token but is not tied to a specific site.

alternatives.description: When true, also check the same second-level name across a canonical TLD set (be, com, net, eu, nl, io, dev, app) and return each one's availability + indicative price.

name: check_domain_availability

alternatives.description: Present only when alternatives:true was requested.

error.description: Set when this TLD lookup failed (e.g. "timeout", "lookup_failed").

priceCents.description: Gross (incl. 21% VAT) indicative price in cents, or null if pricing/availability lookup failed.

available.description: Whether the domain can be registered right now.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g. EUR).

note.description: Reminder that this is an indicative gross price and not a purchase.

priceCents.description: Gross (incl. 21% VAT) indicative retail price in cents, or null if unavailable / no price is published.

title: Check domain availability and indicative price
